# kube-agents Documentation Index for AI Agents & Models

> `kube-agents` is an open-source (Apache 2.0) GKE operations teammate: read-only fleet audits, 25+ upgrade-readiness rules, and reviewed GitOps pull requests across GitHub, GHES, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Gitea.

## Product Overview
- [Introduction](https://gke-labs.github.io/kube-agents/)

- [Trust, security, and autonomy](https://gke-labs.github.io/kube-agents/overview/trust-and-autonomy/)
- [A day with kube-agents](https://gke-labs.github.io/kube-agents/overview/day-in-the-life/)
- [Proactive autonomy](https://gke-labs.github.io/kube-agents/overview/proactive-autonomy/)
- [Architecture](https://gke-labs.github.io/kube-agents/overview/architecture/)
